named_instruments_referenced: UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities
Union of Equality Strategy for the Rights of Persons with Disabilities 2021-2030
annotation.summary_en: EESC exploratory opinion, requested by the Polish Presidency, on including persons with disabilities amid new technologies and AI. It addresses discrimination risks in AI recruitment, banking and insurance, accessibility, reasonable accommodation, digital skills and assistive technologies, and recommends disability-inclusive design, audits, funding and training.
key_provisions_or_claims: Involve persons with disabilities throughout AI design, development, assessment and implementation.
Member States and EU should audit how inclusive AI applications are in critical fields.
Further analysis needed on protecting persons with disabilities from limited-risk AI in employment and recruitment.
Ensure accessibility under Directive 2019/882 and explore specific accessibility standards for AI.
Increase funding for digital skills, accessibility R&D and inclusive design training in curricula.
